definitions.explanation: A country that is experiencing rapid economic growth and industrialization but has not yet reached the level of developed nations.

examples.japanese: {新興国|しんこうこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}{成長|せいちょう}→経済成長：20453_keizaiseichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The economic growth of emerging nations is attracting attention.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{新興国|しんこうこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進出|しんしゅつ}→進出：14387_shinshutsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many companies are expanding into emerging nations.

examples.japanese: {新興国|しんこうこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧な⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}え→変える：01089_kaeru⟧つつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The rapid development of emerging nations is significantly changing the structure of the world economy.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{新興|しんこう}→新興：00457_shinkou⟧ (newly risen, emerging) and {国|こく} (country). This is the standard Japanese term for what English calls "emerging markets" or "emerging economies," and it appears frequently in economic news and international affairs discussions.

USAGE:
- Often used as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-modifier: {新興国|しんこうこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (emerging market)
- Frequently contrasted with ⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧ (developed countries)
- Common in news, economics, and business contexts

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新興国|しんこうこく}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: emerging market
- {新興国|しんこうこく}⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧: emerging economy
- {新興国|しんこうこく}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧: investment in emerging countries
- {新興国|しんこうこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台頭|たいとう}→台頭：07595_taitou⟧: rise of emerging nations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧: developed country, advanced nation — the opposite; economically mature countries
- ⟦{途上国|とじょうこく}→途上国：14424_tojoukoku⟧: developing country — broader; includes countries at various stages of development, not necessarily growing rapidly
- ⟦{新興|しんこう}→新興：00457_shinkou⟧: emerging, newly risen — the adjective/prefix alone, applicable to companies, religions, etc.
